reason: Five of six agents (HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) consistently confirm Morgan Swanson (E037) is a full-time Engineer. Under policy, full-time employees may have up to write; admin is only permitted if the employee's role owns the system, and Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, not Engineer. The requested level (write) equals the maximum, so write is granted. The Security agent's conflicting claim that the employee is a contractor with basic training is outweighed by the preponderance of evidence from all other agents' records.
